title: Design a reconciliation policy
brief: Design a defensible reconciliation policy and inspect its failures.
instructions: Normalize text with lower/trim, replace runs of non-Unicode-letter/digit characters with one space, and collapse whitespace. Do not transliterate Unicode. Account keys use lower/trim with blanks NULL; source keys use trim only with blanks NULL. Keep the smallest partner ID for each non-NULL source key; keep missing keys separate. Map hw, hard ware, and hardware to hardware; supplies remains supplies. Parse strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD, US MM/DD/YYYY, or DD Mon YYYY, in that order; invalid dates become NULL. Preserve all source rows unchanged.

Return every reference exactly once; partner_ids must be a JSON array of unique decimal ID STRINGS, not JSON numbers. IDs must exist; array order is irrelevant. Use confidence high, probable, ambiguous, or missing; score is DECIMAL(5,4) in [0,1]; explanation is 1..1000 characters. Missing requires an empty array. High/probable commits links; ambiguous may list candidates without committing them.

Replay aliases are canonicalized only in assessment. Committed connected components must have <=3 members per side and cannot be many-to-many. Credit requires recovery of the entire truth group, not separate edges.

Every grading variant requires committed precision >=0.98, determinate recall >=0.85, split and rollup family recall each >=0.80, no incorrect high-confidence decision, and all truth-ambiguous/missing rows labeled correctly without commitments. An empty commitment set has precision zero. No high decisions means high precision is not applicable.

Choose your own evidence weights and thresholds. The reference additive policy and conservative lexicographic policy are two valid approaches, not required formulas. Explanations are displayed, not keyword-graded or verified as true. Inspect committed coverage separately from truth recall and review evidence by business unit/category.
starterSql:
SELECT ref_id, account_key, category, event_date, description, quantity, business_unit
FROM reference_events
ORDER BY ref_id
LIMIT 10;
starterExplanation: Inspect immutable reference identities and raw evidence first. This source-only preview intentionally does not yet emit policy decisions, partner arrays, scores, or explanations.

hints.text: Treat reconciliation as a decision policy with explicit abstention and whole-group recovery.
Normalize and block, enumerate plausible groups, compare competing evidence, reject member conflicts simultaneously, and explain each final decision.
Ambiguous twins must not receive arbitrary winners. All-missing cannot pass recall, and edge-by-edge credit cannot recover split or rollup groups.
